description: This file implements the TrialComparisonCertVerifier class, which manages certificate verification jobs with a primary and trial verifier, including job state management, verification process coordination, and result comparison for testing different verification paths.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a verification job that manages primary and trial certificate verification processes, compares results, and reports outcomes.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request
classes.description: Represents a verification request issued to a Job, managing client callbacks and coordinating job completion or abortion.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Job
methods.description: Constructor initializing a verification job with configuration, parameters, and parent verifier reference.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::~Job
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up requests and logging cancellation if needed.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Start
methods.description: Begins the verification process, first with the primary verifier, and sets up callbacks for completion.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Marks the job as having a configuration change, affecting subsequent verification steps.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::DetachRequest
methods.description: Detaches the client request from the job, typically when the request is being canceled.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Finish
methods.description: Completes the job, logs results, and triggers callback or cleanup.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::FinishSuccess
methods.description: Marks the job as successfully completed with a specific result code.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::FinishWithError
methods.description: Marks the job as failed, determining the result code based on primary and trial errors.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnPrimaryJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of the primary verification, initiates trial verification if applicable.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnTrialJobCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of the trial verification, compares results, and determines if re-verification is needed.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::OnPrimaryReverifyWithSecondaryChainCompleted
methods.description: Handles re-verification with a secondary chain, compares results, and decides whether to ignore differences.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request::Request
methods.description: Constructor for client request, linking it to the parent job and callback.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request::~Request
methods.description: Destructor that detaches from parent job.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request::OnJobComplete
methods.description: Invokes client callback upon job completion, may delete the request.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier::Job::Request::OnJobAborted
methods.description: Handles job abortion, resets callback, may delete the request.
